create_utm_grid_mapping: create a UtmGridMapping with a specific UTM zone, cell size, width, height, and origin coordinates
create_utm_grid_from_bbox: create a UtmGridMapping from a bounding box in UTM coordinates with a given resolution
create_utm_grid_from_latlon: create a UtmGridMapping centered on a lat/lon point with a specified resolution and grid size
rescale_utm_grid: rescale an existing UtmGridMapping to a new cell size while preserving the geographic extent
get_geotransform_info: get the geotransform tuple and EPSG code for a given lat/lon center and image resolution
